verses.geez: ወትቤ፡ መርዓት፡ አይቴ፡ ሖረ፡ ወልድ፡ እኁየ፡ አዋልደ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም። ወትቤ፡ አግሲጦስ፡ አይቴ፡ ኀለፈ፡ ወልድ፡ እኁኪ፡ ወንኅሥሦ፡ ምስሌኪ።
verses.translation: Whither is thy kinsman gone, thou beautiful among women? whither has thy kinsman turned aside? tell us, and we will seek him with thee.

translations.lxx: Whither is thy kinsman gone, thou beautiful among women? whither has thy kinsman turned aside? tell us, and we will seek him with thee.
translations.kjv: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.
translations.ron: Unde s-a dus iubitul tău, cea mai frumoasă-ntre femei? Unde-a plecat al tău iubit, ca să-l cutăm şi noi cu tine?
translations.grk: Ποῦ ἀπῆλθεν ὁ ἀδελφιδός σου ἡ καλὴ ἐν γυναιξὶ; ποῦ ἀπέβλεψεν ὁ ἀδελφιδός σου; καὶ ζητήσομεν αὐτὸν μετὰ σοῦ.

verses.geez: ወልድ፡ እኁየ፡ ወረደ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነቱ። ውስተ፡ አብያተ፡ አፈው። ይርአይ፡ ገነተ፡ ወያስተጋብእ፡ ጽጌያት።
verses.translation: My kinsman is gone down to his garden, to the beds of spice, to feed his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

translations.lxx: My kinsman is gone down to his garden, to the beds of spice, to feed his flock in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
translations.kjv: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
translations.ron: Iubitul meu în grădina lui s-a dus, în straturi d-aromate pline, să-şi pască turma acolo şi crini frumoşi s-adune.
translations.grk: Ἀδελφιδός μου κατέβη εἰς κῆπον αὐτοῦ εἰς φιάλας τοῦ ἀρώματος, ποιμαίνειν ἐν κήποις, καὶ συλλέγειν κρίνα.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ አንቲኒ፡ እንተ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ከመ፡ ሥምረት።
verses.translation: I am my kinsman's, and my kinsman is mine, who feeds among the lilies.

translations.lxx: I am my kinsman's, and my kinsman is mine, who feeds among the lilies.
translations.kjv: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
translations.ron: Eu a iubitului meu sunt şi el este al meu, el printre crini îşi paşte iezii.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ τῷ ἀδελφιδῷ μου, καὶ ἀδελφιδός μου ἐμοί, ὁ ποιμαίνων ἐν τοῖς κρίνοις.

verses.geez: አዳም፡ ከመ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም። መደንግፅት፡ ከመ፡ ሥርዐት።
verses.translation: Thou art fair, my companion, as Pleasure, beautiful as Jerusalem, terrible as armies set in array.

translations.lxx: Thou art fair, my companion, as Pleasure, beautiful as Jerusalem, terrible as armies set in array.
translations.kjv: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as an army with banners.
translations.ron: Frumoasă eşti, iubita mea, frumoasă eşti ca Tirţa şi ca Ierusalimul dragă, dar ca şi oastea în război temută.
translations.grk: Καλὴ εἶ ἡ πλησίον μου, ὡς εὐδοκία, ὡραῖα ὡς Ἱερουσαλὴμ, θάμβος ὡς τεταγμέναι.

verses.geez: ሚጢ፡ አዕይንተኪ፡ እምአንጻርየ። እስመ፡ እማንቱ፡ አስረራኒ፡ ውስተ፡ አየር።
verses.translation: Turn away thine eyes from before me, for they have ravished me: thy hair is as flocks of goats which have appeared from Galaad.

translations.lxx: Turn away thine eyes from before me, for they have ravished me: thy hair is as flocks of goats which have appeared from Galaad.
translations.kjv: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.
translations.ron: Întoarce-ţi ochii de la mine, că ei de tot mă scot din fire.
translations.grk: Ἀπόστρεψον ὀφθαλμούς σου ἀπεναντίον μου, ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἀνεπτέρωσάν με· τρίχωμά σου ὡς ἀγέλαι τῶν αἰγῶν, αἳ ἀνεφάνησαν ἀπὸ τοῦ Γαλαάδ.

verses.geez: ሥዕርትኪ፡ ከመ፡ መርዔተ፡ አጣሊ። እለ፡ አስተርአያ፡ እምአድባረ፡ ገለዓድ። ስነንኪ፡ ከመ፡ መራዕይ፡ እለ፡ ተቀርፃ። እለ፡ ዐርጋ፡ እምኅፃብ። ኵሎን፡ እለ፡ ይመነትዋ። ወአልቦ፡ እምኔሆን፡ መካን።
verses.translation: Thy teeth are as flocks of shorn sheep, that have gone up from the washing, all of them bearing twins, and there is none barren among them: thy lips are as a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely.

translations.lxx: Thy teeth are as flocks of shorn sheep, that have gone up from the washing, all of them bearing twins, and there is none barren among them: thy lips are as a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely.
translations.kjv: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.
translations.ron: Părul tău turme de capre pare, ce din munţi, din Galaad coboară. Dinţii tăi par turmă de oi tunse, ce din scăldătoare ies, făcând două şiruri strânse şi neavând nici o ştirbitură.
translations.grk: Ὀδόντες σου ὡς ἀγέλαι τῶν κεκαρμένων, αἳ ἀνέβησαν ἀπὸ τοῦ λουτροῦ, αἱ πᾶσαι διδυμεύουσαι, καὶ ἀτεκνοῦσα οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐταῖς· ὡς σπαρτίον τὸ κόκκινον χείλη σου, καὶ ἡ λαλιά σου ὡραιᾶ.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ፍሕሶ፡ ቀይሕ፡ ከናፍርኪ። ንባብኪ፡ አዳም። ከመ፡ ቅርፍተ፡ ሮማን፡ መላትሕኪ፡ እንበለ፡ አርምሞትኪ።
verses.translation: Thy cheek is like the rind of a pomegranate, being seen without thy veil.

translations.lxx: Thy cheek is like the rind of a pomegranate, being seen without thy veil.
translations.kjv: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
translations.ron: Două jumătăţi de rodii par obrajii tăi, sub vălul tău cel străveziu.
translations.grk: Ὡς λέπυρον ῥοᾶς μῆλόν σου ἐκτὸς τῆς σιωπήσεώς σου.

verses.geez: ስሳ፡ እማንቱ፡ ንግሥታት፡ ወሰማኒያ፡ ዕቁባት። አዋልድ፡ እለ፡ አልቦን፡ ኍልቊ።
verses.translation: There are sixty queens, and eighty concubines, and maidens without number.

translations.lxx: There are sixty queens, and eighty concubines, and maidens without number.
translations.kjv: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.
translations.ron: Solomon are şaizeci de regine şi optzeci de concubine, iar fecioare socoteala cine le-o mai ţine!
translations.grk: Ἑξήκοντά εἰσι βασίλισσαι καὶ ὀγδοήκοντα παλλακαὶ, καὶ νεάνιδες ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός.

verses.geez: አሐቲ፡ ይእቲ፡ ርግብየ፡ ፍጽምት። ክነፊሃ፡ ክንፈ፡ ብሩር። ወገበዋቲሃኒ፡ በሐመልማለ፡ ወርቅ።
verses.translation: My dove, my perfect one is one; she is the only one of her mother; she is the choice of her that bore her. The daughters saw her, and the queens will pronounce her blessed, yea, and the concubines, and they will praise her.

translations.lxx: My dove, my perfect one is one; she is the only one of her mother; she is the choice of her that bore her. The daughters saw her, and the queens will pronounce her blessed, yea, and the concubines, and they will praise her.
translations.kjv: My dove, my undefiled is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea, the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
translations.ron: Dar ea e numai una, porumbiţa mea, curata mea; una-i ea la a ei mamă, singură născută în casă. Fetele când au văzut-o, laude i-au înălţat, iar reginele şi concubinele osanale i-au cântat.
translations.grk: Μία ἐστὶ περιστερά μου, τελεία μου, μία ἐστὶ τῇ μητρὶ αὐτῆς, ἐκλεκτή ἐστι τῇ τεκούσῃ αὐτήν· Εἴδοσαν αὐτὴν θυγατέρες καὶ μακαριοῦσιν αὐτὴν, βασίλισσαι καί γε παλλακαὶ, καὶ αἰνέσουσιν αὐτήν.

verses.geez: አሐቲ፡ ይእቲ፡ ለእማ። ወኅሪት፡ ይእቲ፡ ለእንተ፡ ወለደታ። ርእያሃ፡ አዋልድ፡ ወአስተብፅዓሃ። ንግሥታት፡ ወዕቁባት፡ ወደሳሃ።
verses.translation: Who is this that looks forth as the morning, fair as the moon, choice as the sun, terrible as armies set in array?

translations.lxx: Who is this that looks forth as the morning, fair as the moon, choice as the sun, terrible as armies set in array?
translations.kjv: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?
translations.ron: Cine-i aceasta, ziceau ele, care ca zarea străluceşte şi ca luna-i de frumoasă, ca soarele-i de luminoasă şi ca oastea de război temută?
translations.grk: Τίς αὕτη ἡ ἐκκύπτουσα ὡσεὶ ὄρθρος, καλὴ ὡς σελήνη, ἐκλεκτὴ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος, θάμβος ὡς τεταγμέναι;

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዛቲ፡ እንተ፡ እንተ፡ ትሔውጽ፡ ከመ፡ ጎሕ። ሠናይት፡ ከመ፡ ወርኀ። ወብርህት፡ ከመ፡ ፀሓይ። ወሑረታቲሃ፡ በምሥጢር። ድንጋፄ፡ ከመ፡ ሥርዐት።
verses.translation: I went down to the garden of nuts, to look at the fruits of the valley, to see if the vine flowered, if the pomegranates blossomed.

translations.lxx: I went down to the garden of nuts, to look at the fruits of the valley, to see if the vine flowered, if the pomegranates blossomed.
translations.kjv: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.
translations.ron: La grădina nucilor m-am dus, ca să văd verdeaţa văii, dacă a dat vita de vie şi dacă merii au înflorit.
translations.grk: Εἰς κῆπον καρύας κατέβην ἰδεῖν ἐν γεννήμασι τοῦ χειμάῤῥου, ἰδεῖν εἰ ἤνθησεν ἡ ἄμπελος, ἐξήνθησαν αἱ ῥοαί·

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ ገነት፡ ከርካዕ፡ ወረደ፡ ወልድ፡ እኁየ፡ ውስተ፡ ዘርዐ፡ ሙሓዝ። ኀበ፡ ፈረየ፡ አከያሞስ። ይርአይ፡ ለእመ፡ ጸገየ፡ ወይን። ወለእመ፡ ፈረየ፡ ሮማን።
verses.translation: There I will give thee my breasts: my soul knew it not: it made me as the chariots of Aminadab.

translations.lxx: There I will give thee my breasts: my soul knew it not: it made me as the chariots of Aminadab.
translations.kjv: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.
translations.ron: Şi nu ştiu cum s-a petrecut, că a mea inimă m-a dus la oştirea de război a viteazului meu neam.
translations.grk: Ἐκεῖ δώσω τοὺς μαστούς μου σοί· οὐκ ἔγνω ἡ ψυχή μου· ἔθετο με ἅρματα Ἀμιναδάβ.

verses.geez: በህየ፡ እውህበከ፡ አጥባትየ፡ ለከ። ነፍስየ፡ ኢያእመረት። ረስየኒ፡ ሠረገላተ፡ ዐሚናዳብ።

translations.kjv: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.

verses.geez: ወይቤላ፡ ተመየጢ፡ ተመየጢ፡ ሱላማጢስ። ተመየጢ፡ ወንርአይ፡ ብኪ፡ ሰላመ።
